info.title: AapdaSaathi API
info.description:
Disaster-alert accountability platform by Team PRIME ERA (SAARTHI'26). App where possible. SMS everywhere. A human for those who don't reply.

All timestamps are UTC. Errors: `{"error": {"code", "message"}}`.
